subject: Accelerant POC — on-site day, livestream & badging coordination
messages:
From: Alicia Torres <alicia@accelerant.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerant POC at Redwood HQ — request for visit day and livestream

Hi Markus / Lauren,

Thanks again for offering Redwood as a site for our proof-of-concept day. We'd like to bring a small delegation to HQ to run hands-on tests with your team and do a short demo for our remote engineers via livestream. A few initial asks so we can lock a date: 

- Preferred visit day: any weekday the week of Aug 31–Sep 4 (we're flexible).
- Headcount: 6 in-person + 2 remote observers.
- We'll need a conference room with a livestream setup (HD camera + ability to stream to Zoom or RTMP).
- NDA: we'd prefer a mutual NDA signed before the visit — can you share your visitor NDA?
- Catering: light lunch for 6, and one vegetarian.

Attached is a preliminary attendee spreadsheet (names + orgs). Can you confirm availability and any required visitor paperwork?

Best,
Alicia Torres
Head of Solutions, Accelerant AI
Alicia Torres
A: accelerant.ai

Attachment: Accelerant_attendee_list.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@accelerant.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerant POC at Redwood HQ — request for visit day and livestream

Hi Alicia — thanks for the details and the list. Happy to host. A few quick items and options so we can lock logistics: 

- Available windows at our Novato HQ next week: Tue Sep 1 (09:30–16:00) or Thu Sep 3 (10:00–15:00). Which works better?
- We can provide a conference suite (Room A: 12-person) with a PTZ camera and a streaming pod. AV will support Zoom/RTMP. 
- Security requires a signed visitor NDA and a CSV of attendee names by 48 hours before arrival for badge printing. I can send our standard visitor NDA now for signature.
- Catering: we typically use Redwood Catering (sandwich box + fruit). Let us know dietary restrictions.
- Run-of-show: please share any required demo hardware or network access (e.g., test VPNs, ports).

I've attached our visitor NDA and a short AV checklist and can produce a run-of-show template once we have the final agenda. David (cc) will own badging and building escort.

If you confirm Thu Sep 3, I'll reserve Room A and notify Facilities to set up the stream.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Director, Partner Eng
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Accelerant_NDA-Redwood.pdf (pdf, 23KB); AV_checklist.md (md, 4KB)

Hi Markus,

Thanks — Thu Sep 3 works best for our team. Confirming: 6 in-person, 2 remote observers. No special hardware beyond a laptop and a test dataset we'll bring (we will not require VPN).

A couple of clarifications: 
- We'll sign the NDA today — do you prefer DocuSign? Please send the link.
- For livestream: we plan to stream the demo for two remote engineers in India — 1pm PT demo slot would be ideal.
- Catering: one vegetarian and one vegan among the six.

I've uploaded an updated attendee CSV (names + emails) to the thread. Samir will coordinate any open security questions.

Best,
Alicia

Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerant POC at Redwood HQ — run-of-show & day-of logistics

Alicia — great, Thu Sep 3 is confirmed. Below is the run-of-show and items we need from you. Please reply with the finalized attendee CSV and signed NDA (DocuSign link included).

Day-of (Thu Sep 3) — Room A (12-person)
- 09:30 — Doors open / badges & coffee (badges printed from CSV)
- 10:00 — Kickoff / intros (Redwood leadership + Accelerant)
- 11:00 — Deep-dive technical session (workstations + laptop demos)
- 13:00 — Live demo & Q&A (streamed to Zoom; we will record)
- 14:00 — Wrap / follow-ups / next steps

AV + security notes:
- We will stream via Redwood Zoom account (RTMP fallback available). AV will test camera/mic at 09:45. If you want to push to a private RTMP, send credentials 24h before.
- Security will need the attendee CSV no later than Tue Sep 1 10:00 PT to pre-print badges. Please include legal names and DOBs for contractors if possible.
- NDA: use this DocuSign envelope to sign both copies — https://docusign.com/accelerant-poc-ndas/abcdef123456

Attachments included: Run_of_Show_Accelerant_20260831.pdf (pdf, 56KB), AV_checklist.md (md, 6KB), visitor_badge_template.csv (csv, 1KB).

David will be the day contact for badging and escort. Lauren will be the technical lead on Redwood's side. I'll be on-site for the morning and the demo.

Thanks — looking forward to hosting.

— Markus
Director, Partner Eng
Redwood Inference
